newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Overweight Thai stocks - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Overweight Thai stocks - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch recommended overweighting of Thai stocks as prospects improved with a new government line-up expected after elections on November 17, a moderate improvement in the current account deficit and a more relaxed monetary policy.
"We believe it's time to lower our guard on Thai equities," Merrill Lynch said in a report received on Thursday.
